description: Corrected +1/+2 flank comparison of CG42404 PPPY against characterized Drosophila WW-domain PY ligands
code:
import requests, re
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT="/agent/jobs/6811dc4d-ddff-4159-9963-5139baa317dd/provenance"

def get(q):
    r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
      params={"query":q,"fields":"accession,sequence,length","format":"json","size":5},timeout=120)
    return r.json().get("results",[])

targets=[("Commissureless (comm)","gene_exact:comm AND organism_id:7227 AND reviewed:true"),
         ("Expanded (ex)","gene_exact:ex AND organism_id:7227 AND reviewed:true"),
         ("Warts (wts)","gene_exact:wts AND organism_id:7227 AND reviewed:true"),
         ("Hippo (hpo)","gene_exact:hpo AND organism_id:7227 AND reviewed:true"),
         ("Tgi / SdBP","gene_exact:tgi AND organism_id:7227"),
         ("Myopic (mop)","gene_exact:mop AND organism_id:7227 AND reviewed:true"),
         ("NcoA6","gene_exact:Ncoa6 AND organism_id:7227")]

rows=[]
cg="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q9VFA8.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])
def add(name,acc,s):
    for m in re.finditer(r"[LP]P.Y", s):
        a=m.start()           # 0-based first residue of motif
        yi=a+3                # 0-based Tyr
        rows.append(dict(protein=name, acc=acc, motif=m.group(), motif_start=a+1,
                         p1=s[yi+1] if yi+1<len(s) else "-", p2=s[yi+2] if yi+2<len(s) else "-",
                         context=s[max(0,a-6):a+16]))
add("CG42404 (this gene)","Q9VFA8",cg)
for name,q in targets:
    res=get(q)
    if not res: print("no UniProt hit:",name); continue
    add(name, res[0]["primaryAccession"], res[0]["sequence"]["value"])

df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
df["n_acidic_at_+1+2"]=[sum(c in "DE" for c in (r.p1,r.p2)) for r in df.itertuples()]
print("=== Drosophila PY motifs: residues immediately C-terminal to the Tyr ===")
print(df.to_string(index=False, max_colwidth=24))
df.to_csv(f"{OUT}/drosophila_PY_motif_ligand_comparison.csv", index=False)

tot=len(df)
print(f"\nOf {tot} PY motifs in these Drosophila WW-domain ligands:")
print(f"  both +1 and +2 acidic: {(df['n_acidic_at_+1+2']==2).sum()}  -> "
      f"{', '.join(df.loc[df['n_acidic_at_+1+2']==2,'protein']+' '+df.loc[df['n_acidic_at_+1+2']==2,'motif']+'@'+df.loc[df['n_acidic_at_+1+2']==2,'motif_start'].astype(str))}")
print(f"  at least one acidic:   {(df['n_acidic_at_+1+2']>=1).sum()}")

print("\n--- Architecture comparison with the NMR structure in PMID 16531238 ---")
print("Comm PY2 ligand solved bound to dNedd4 WW3*:  T G L P S Y | D E | A L H   (PPII motif, then helical turn)")
print("CG42404 191-208:                              E A P P P Y | E E | A V A I S Q A E A L")
print("Both present a PY core, two acidic residues at +1/+2, then a hydrophobic helical element.")
print("The AlphaFold ortholog models predict CA(i)-CA(i+4) ~6.0 A through EEAVAISQAEAL, i.e. alpha-helical.")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,4.2))
y=np.arange(len(df))
ax.barh(y, df["n_acidic_at_+1+2"], color=["#E45756" if p.startswith("CG42404") else
        ("#F58518" if p.startswith("Comm") else "#4C78A8") for p in df.protein])
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([f"{r.protein.split(' (')[0]}  {r.motif}@{r.motif_start}" for r in df.itertuples()],fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("number of acidic residues (D/E) at positions +1 and +2 after the PY tyrosine")
ax.set_xticks([0,1,2]); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_title("CG42404 shares the di-acidic +1/+2 flank of the Comm PY motif that binds dNedd4 WW3*\n(red = CG42404, orange = Commissureless, blue = Hippo pathway PY ligands)",fontsize=9.5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
